findings.title: The bell's list stays open over the public home page after the session is revoked, still showing the signed-out account's notifications
steps: Sign in as sofer2@example.test on /app/driver (320 px phone or 1440 px desktop)
Admin sends a test notification; tap the bell so the list (drawer / bottom sheet) is open
In a second tab of the same browser, complete a password reset for the same account (session.revoked)
Tab 1 leaves /app/driver for / as ST-127 intends, but the 'Notificări' drawer stays open on top of the public page with the previous account's rows and 'Marchează tot ca citit'
findings.evidence: Seen at both viewports in lap 4 at b54ed60: shots/flow-revoked-desktop-tab1.png (drawer with 'Mesaj de test: notificările funcționează.', unread mark and 'Marchează tot ca citit' over the home page), shots/flow-revoked-small-phone-tab1.png (bottom sheet over the home page). Overlays.open() leaves closing to CDK, which closes on a history change (popstate) but not on Router.navigateByUrl, so the overlay outlives the Frame and its Bell. This is not caused by the merge: revoked() was already in frame.ts at 357a8b6, and lap 3 did not cover this path. Fix (test first): close the bell's list when the session ends or the Frame is destroyed (e.g. BellList or Bell closes its ref when Session.current() becomes null, or in a DestroyRef callback). frame.ts:212-216 (session.ended: signed out in another tab) navigates the same way and may show the same thing; that path was not tested here.
